newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt seeks 30,000 t yellow corn, 30,000t soybean.
newsitem.headline: Egypt seeks 30,000 t yellow corn, 30,000t soybean.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Food Industries Company said on Thursday it wanted to buy 30,000 tonnes of yellow corn for arrival in the second half of September and/or the second half of October.

The corn should be Grade 2 or better and must be U.S. or Argentine origin, said Muharram Ghanem, the head of the sales department at the company. The deadline for bids is noon (0900 GMT) on July 22, he told Reuters.
The Food Industries Company also said it was seeking 30,000 tonnes of soybean, any origin, for arrival in the first half of October and/or the first half of November.
The deadline for the soybean tender is also noon (0900 GMT) on July 22, Ghanem said. --Jonathan Wright +20 2 578 3290/1
